text:
maria: Heads-up — planning to enable v3.1-catalog model in the EU and US change window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 UTC. Need agreement on traffic hedge, pin list, and rollback thresholds.
kevin: +1. What traffic hedge are we thinking? 10% -> 50% over 30m?
maria: Thinking conservative: 5% initial for 10m, then 20% for 20m, then evaluate metrics before wider roll. Keep fallback ordering: current-prod -> quant-v2 -> small-latency.
sam: We should pin a short drain window for older variant: 30m drain after traffic shift start. Pin list: keep customer-critical models pinned (see /pins/customer-critical).
deploybot: preflight checks: 
```
checks: [config-valid, model-artifacts-present, telemetry-hooked, slot-availability]
result: config-valid:ok, model-artifacts-present:ok, telemetry-hooked:warning (missing eval set), slot-availability:ok
```
deploybot: Please resolve telemetry warning before approval or acknowledge risk with rollback plan.
jin: Telemetry team — we can wire a lightweight eval set in 2h, but we need the prompt set from product. If not available, add a synthetic smoke set and enable regression alerting.
olivia: Product can provide the minimal prompt set by EOD today. Also drafting release notes — need a clear bullet about expected latency regressions and cost delta.
kevin: Rollback thresholds proposal: 99p latency increase >25% for 10m OR error rate spike >0.5% absolute for 5m -> immediate rollback. Also set a soft pause trigger at 10% latency increase to stop progression.
maria: Sounds good. Add an ops-safe fallback: if latency SLO hit in eu region, route new traffic to US until issue resolved.
sam: Confirming pin behavior: any pinned model stays at 100% for pinned routes — we'll exclude pinned routes from the initial hedge.
jin: Telemetry gating: enable a regression eval job that runs every 5m during window and posts to #model-telemetry with a strict flag for regressions. I can hook that.
olivia: I'll add a short blurb to release notes: "Enabling v3.1-catalog in EU/US with phased traffic hedge; fallback ordering configured; telemetry gating enabled; rollback thresholds specified."
maria: Final check: anyone object to enabling given deploybot preflight? If not, we'll approve and schedule for change window.
kevin: No objections from infra side.
sam: Ops ready for 09:00 UTC. I'll be on-call during the window.
jin: Telemetry hook will be live by 08:30 UTC.
deploybot: approval requested: set `enable=true` for v3.1-catalog in catalog-config and schedule at 1761200400 (09:00 UTC tomorrow).
maria: Approved. I'll update the runbook with these thresholds and pin list and ping release channel 30m before start. :thumbsup:
